claim: NVIDIA’s jump from $26.9B in 2023A to $60.9B in 2024A (+125.9%), then nearly doubling again to $130.5B in 2025A, reflects rapid adoption of GPU and data center solutions by hyperscale and enterprise customers.
review_reason: Numeric component is supported but asserted customer-adoption cause is not. Compound claim conservatively unsupported; separate extracted numeric claims retained.

claim: NVIDIA's forward guidance suggests revenue may exceed $130 billion in 2025.
review_reason: Historical 2025A revenue is not forward guidance; no guidance source was supplied.

claim: NVIDIA's EBITDA and margins are forecast to continue expanding.
review_reason: Reviewer cited actual A columns, not forecast evidence; flat baseline margins do not demonstrate expansion.

claim: Peers AMD and Intel lag considerably in EBITDA performance, especially as AI adoption and data center demand accelerate.
review_reason: Peer EBITDA supports relative comparison but does not establish the compounded AI-demand assertion.

claim: NVIDIA Corporation has industry-leading profitability reflected in high EBITDA margins.
review_reason: Classification contradicted its own reasoning: missing evidence explicitly acknowledged.
